GOV-F-003-S134.title: Brain Lock Schema and Ownership Contract
GOV-F-003-S134.description: Define and implement the Brain lock schema including owner_id, ttl_expiry, heartbeat_timestamp, and lock_state. Establish contract rules for valid ownership, expiration, and renewal to ensure consistency across services.

GOV-F-003-S135.title: Brain Lock API Endpoints for Acquire, Heartbeat, and Release
GOV-F-003-S135.description: Expose backend interfaces for lock acquisition, heartbeat renewal, and release operations. Ensure endpoints enforce TTL validation, ownership checks, and safe failure handling for concurrent callers.

GOV-F-003-S136.title: Brain Runner Integration with Lock Lifecycle
GOV-F-003-S136.description: Integrate lock acquisition, heartbeat, and release into brain_runner execution flow to ensure all assignment processing is protected by TTL-bound ownership and supports recovery on failure.

GOV-F-003-S137.title: Observability and Debug Logging for Lock Events
GOV-F-003-S137.description: Add structured logging for lock lifecycle events including acquire, heartbeat, expiration, recovery, and conflicts. Ensure logs support debugging of race conditions and production incident analysis.
